pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo paripuṇṇadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ saṃghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.8: nāma bhikkhuniyo paripuṇṇadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ saṃghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpessantīti . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.16: anujānāmi bhikkhave paripuṇṇadvādasavassāya gihigatāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.18: tāya paripuṇṇadvādasavassāya gihigatāya dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā . . . (LXIII.1) . . . vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.19: ahaṃ ayye itthannāmā itthannāmāya ayyāya paripuṇṇadvādasavassā gihigatā dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā saṃghaṃ vuṭṭhānasammutiṃ yācāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.24: Instead of sikkhamānā read paripuṇṇadvādasavassā gihigatā dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhā; instead
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.25: of dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhāsammuti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.34: atha kho bhagavā tā bhikkhuniyo anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc67:1.36.1: yā pana bhikkhunī paripuṇṇadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhaṃ saṃghena asammataṃ vuṭṭhāpeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
